mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings produced since 2024, reported as out of spec and sliding onto the cap and block groove without proper interference fit, raising a spun-thrust risk. The snippet states a King tech support rep said they personally would not use them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the OP reports switching to NOS Clevite thrust bearings that measured in spec.
